//: Story Phase 14: the Grand Bank Ledger, in the Acting Grand Teller's own (deplorable) handwriting. One entry per depositor, as they're served. The bank is gone; the ledger stayed.

bank_ledger.title: The Grand Bank Ledger
bank_ledger.byline: <k>Kept by</> Captain Stinkbeard, Acting Grand Teller of Grand Atmospheric Assets. <k>Audited by</> Madame Windledger (deplorable).

entries.title: Grand Duchess Windabella the Imperious
entries.depositor: Grand Duchess of the Upper Breezes, Keeper of the Crimson Sash
entries.notes: Furniture-moving. Table moved four feet. Did not apologise. Did not look.

entries.title: Sir Gassius Thunderbottom
entries.depositor: Knight of the Ceremonial Bean, Thunderbottom of Thunderbottom Hall
entries.notes: Structural. Crack in mainmast (small). Smelled of pepper for an hour.

entries.title: Lady Rumblewaft the Resolute
entries.depositor: Holder of the Long Waft, Patience of the Southern Shore
entries.notes: Furniture-aware. Duration: 1 hour 14 min (estimated). Arms gone. Tea made twice.

entries.title: Lord Puffington the Enduring
entries.depositor: Lord Puffington the Enduring, Ninety-Seven, Eater of Fibre
entries.telegraph: Very old. Very frail. Seems quite harmless.
entries.notes: MARITIME. HE IS NINETY-SEVEN. Fibre. (Do not trust the old ones.)

entries.title: Grand Stenchmistress Breezella the Bold
entries.depositor: Grand Stenchmistress of Acceleration, Youngest Ever Certified
entries.telegraph: Fast. Then, a moment later: FAST.
entries.notes: Structural, delayed. The wave comes LATER. Watch for the wave.

entries.title: Little Grand Gustavius
entries.telegraph: A small boy in an enormous sash.
entries.notes: Maritime. Aged seven and three quarters. 'The secret is beans.' (It is.)

entries.title: Grand Toddler Puffalina
entries.depositor: Grand Toddler, Heiress to the Little Breeze
entries.notes: MUNICIPAL. AGED TWO. The second one. ALWAYS the second one.

entries.title: Dr. Flatulon Ventworth
entries.depositor: Professor of Applied Atmospherics, Fellow of the Grand Society

entries.title: Madame Windledger
entries.depositor: Grand Auditor of the Grand Trust
entries.telegraph: She is looking at your handwriting.
entries.notes: Structural. Moved the COUNTER. With me behind it. My fives are FINE.

entries.title: Captain Gasbeth
entries.depositor: Pirate Grand Stenchmaster, Terror of the Windward Isles
entries.telegraph: Another captain. She's eyeing your cannons.
entries.notes: Maritime. Fired a cannon. One captain to another: respect.

entries.title: Baron Thundergut
entries.telegraph: Huge. Three sashes. You have to hold all three.
entries.notes: Municipal. Three sashes. Human chain: Pete, Gristle, Bob, Jim, Ned. (Squawks supervised.)

entries.title: Grand Miniature Duke Puff
entries.depositor: Grand Miniature Duke, Master of Concentrated Output
entries.notes: Maritime. 'PT.' Then the BELL. Split in two. From across the DECK.

entries.title: The Grand Wind Twins
entries.depositor: Joint Account Holders, the Synchronised Sashes of Breezemouth
entries.notes: Maritime. Two waves. They met in me. Beard: vertical (temporarily).

entries.title: Grand Duke Rumpington
entries.depositor: Grand Duke Rumpington of the Lower Rumps, Hereditary Bench-Warmer
entries.telegraph: A great deal of velvet. A great deal of man.
entries.notes: Structural. Ned on his back. Ned fine.

entries.title: Beatrice of the Violet Sash
entries.telegraph: A violet sash. A very nice violet sash.
entries.notes: Furniture-moving. Pleasant. Coils neater after. (The only nice one.)

entries.title: Gary
entries.depositor: Grand High Exalted Ambassador of the Tempestuous Bottom, Viscount of the Seventh Gust, Keeper of the Eternal Bean

entries.title: Grand Empress Zephyrella the Uncontainable
entries.depositor: Grand Empress of the Four Winds, Mover of the Mount of Oomph
entries.notes: HISTORIC. The storm STOPPED. (One breath.) Mountain: seven feet, apparently.

entries.title: Grand Patriarch Rumbleseptimus the World-Weary
entries.depositor: Grand Patriarch of the First Rumble, Continental Class (Retired)
entries.notes: PLEASE NOTIFY AUTHORITIES. A continent moved. He was BORED.

entries.title: Grandmother Gustilda
entries.notes: VALUE: UNMEASURABLE. 10+. ABSOLUTELY NOT. She wanted a RECEIPT.
